2026-09-27.body:
Hi,

Here's a summary of what I worked on this week:

Stagwell AI
• /products rebuilt from the client deck: new suite order, same card for every product, new pictures, and a vertical list on phones
• The Show me menu rebuilt as the client's Solutions by FAQs dropdown
• All client fixes from the docs applied on the product pages and /products
• The product owners' copy added to the product pages
• New on every product page: the fan scene, related-product cards, and a mockup for each tab based on each team's own screens
• New From signal to action section on the four Stagwell Machines pages
• Footer alignment, a Call my phone button on every page, and updates on the home page (Expertise awards reel, suite pictures)

NewIntel
• Logo updated
• The site updated with the new logo, and the NewIntel name applied across all sites, dashboards, mockups and tooltip pages

NEW
• Worked on the new logo

InfluencerMarketing.Ai
• Built the MQL onboarding prototype: split-screen layout on desktop and a stacked layout on mobile, with the new logo and hero photo

Thanks,
Julian
